shared_elements: carved stone monument with anthropomorphic or symbolic imagery
justification: Both are upright carved stone monoliths bearing incised imagery arranged in horizontal bands, and both include a circular disc-like motif, but A depicts a clearly anthropomorphic figure (head, arms, torso outline) in a rounded naturalistic-schematic style, while B shows a flat slab with animal figures (bird, possibly other creatures) and abstract arch-like patterns in a linear incised style. The overall composition and subject matter differ substantially beyond the shared general format of a decorated standing stone.'
